thought.text: Node installed. Now activate node+pnpm globally via mise and install forego:

reasoning_content:
Node 24.22.0 is already installed via mise, but it's not activated. mise only auto-activates tools listed in config files. Need to enable it globally: run `mise use -g node`, or configure it globally. Let's use `mise use -g node@24.22.0 pnpm` — this writes to the global config (not the repo, so it's fine).

Also, pnpm is needed too: the packageManager field in package.json is pnpm@11.25.0. pnpm also needs to be installed (via mise) and corepack can be used as an alternative. Let's install pnpm@11 with mise and enable both globally.

action.command: docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc 'cd /workspaces/workspace; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; mise use -g node@24.22.0 2>&1 | tail -2; mise install pnpm@11 2>&1 | tail -3; mise use -g pnpm 2>&1 | tail -2; hash -r; node -v; pnpm -v; corepack --version 2>/dev/null | head -1'
